distribution.summary: Fujian; Guangxi; Jiangxi; Sichuan; Xizang; Yunnan; Taiwan
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Anisandrus hirtus from Fujian, Guangxi, Jiangxi, Sichuan, Xizang, Yunnan and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently supports Taiwan; no new mainland province is inferred.

host_note: Family-level associations from Smith et al. (2020) are retained at family resolution. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds the resolved Taiwan host Zelkova formosana, recorded under Xyleborus taiwanensis.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Anisandrus hirtus (Hagedorn, 1904).
